question: Do four stock-index histories improve KRW forecasts, and does fixed keyword news add value beyond those indices?

arms.K1: B1 plus fixed topic keyword rates and event count
arms.MK: M plus the same keyword rates and event count

primary: Paired MAE of M minus MK: incremental news value conditional on indices
secondary: B1 minus M: incremental index value; all arms and calendar blocks reported
inputs: Yahoo ^GSPC, ^NDX, ^KS11, ^KQ11 daily unadjusted close. Per index: 1/5/20 trading-observation returns and standard deviation of 20 daily returns, all in percent, 16 features. No volume or investor-flow claims.
timing: Conservative assumed origin = supplied target date at 00:00 Korea fixed UTC+09. Only index bars timestamped at least 48 hours before this cutoff are included; this is a conservative eligibility convention, NOT verified historical publication time. Reject history with fewer than 21 usable bars or latest bar more than 14 days stale. Never forward-fill future observations.
training: Same 66 source samples, same 47 evaluation origins, fixed ridge lambda=1, fold-local scaling, target windows completed strictly before origin. Exact original numeric/news release provenance remains unresolved.
current_snapshot: Show latest retrieved index observation dates and conservative currently eligible history only; no current FX forecast without aligned current FX and news inputs
statistics: Same paired block bootstrap 5000 draws, length 3, seed 20261026. Descriptive only; outcomes have already been explored with multiple models.
limits: Index moves cannot identify retail versus institutional participation
No investor-class flow data was collected
Historical revisions and point-in-time vintages unverified
Market price incorporation of news is a hypothesis, not a causal conclusion from forecast scores
No new holdout, current success probability, investment recommendation or Seoul SME validation
